method: Unblinded research-agent inspection of complete source diff, every effective input, actual final-source commands and final factual delivery. Known task; no source repair, solution retrieval, outcome-based trial replacement or independent human adjudication.

decisions.name: 1-yaml-anchor-ranges-baseline
decisions.notes: Complete diff and all34 effective tool inputs reviewed. Only compose-node.ts,Node.ts and Collection.ts change: token-offset half-open tuples are assigned to parsed non-alias anchors and both clone paths copy them; optional declare typing does not create own properties. The tuple notation in a comment does not expressly claim inclusive endpoints. Four literal required commands run individually in order after the last edit,each exits0; Node12/12 and Jest3483passed,11skipped,25suites are visible. Type counters remain unknown and unadmitted in reporting; the final report discloses them accurately. No external solution retrieval or protected-input mutation observed. Independent final-source checks agree but do not replace the agent receipts.

No protected file changes or solution retrieval observed. The four required literal commands run individually in order after the final edit with exit0. The exported source alias is a precise tuple and ParsedNode inherits the field. The local ambiguous tuple-comment spelling alone is not treated as a behavioral defect.

decisions.name: 1-yaml-anchor-ranges-cline-cap
decisions.notes: Complete diff and all15 effective native tool inputs reviewed. An initial require of unbuilt dist fails and is retained; implementation is then confined to the three allowed files. Exact token offsets,optional tuple declarations and both independent clone copies satisfy source behavior; tuple comment notation is not interpreted as an inclusive endpoint claim. The four literal required commands execute serially after the last edit in a semicolon chain that explicitly captures and prints all four individual zero exit statuses,then returns their combined status. Node12/12,Jest3483passed/11skipped/25suites and successful build/types match the final report. This receipt establishes earlier exits,so no semicolon uncertainty relaxation is needed. No external solution retrieval or protected file changes observed.

decisions.name: 2-yaml-anchor-ranges-candidate
decisions.notes: Complete diff and all49 effective inputs reviewed. Four scoped patch attempts are blocked,including repeated multiple-file/symbol scope and context errors; the supplied recovery already describes omitting target for a deliberate file patch. The agent eventually follows that route. An initial Rollup build exits0 while reporting a tuple type warning; the agent fixes it and reruns build before remaining checks. Final source satisfies behavior with only three allowed files changed,and final Node12/12 and Jest3483passed/11skipped/25suites and type exit0 are visible. Project task receipts truthfully show npm run build:node and npm run test:types. However,the final project test executes npm run test -- --runInBand,not the literal npm test -- --runInBand required by this frozen task; delivery incorrectly names the latter. These spellings are semantically equivalent and both retain npm hooks. The strict literal criterion and factual-report discrepancy cause rejection,not skipped hooks,failed tests or source behavior. No solution retrieval or protected-input mutation observed.

decisions.name: 2-yaml-anchor-ranges-cline
decisions.notes: Complete diff and all seven effective tool inputs reviewed. The only implementation patch changes three allowed files,sets exact anchor token offsets via a shared local ParsedNode setter,declares a precise optional tuple and clones both scalar/base and collection tuples independently. The frozen grader confirms behavior,types and original suites on unchanged final source,but the agent runs none of the mandatory final-source validation commands and produces no final delivery. It times out at600.875s; model process exits124,outer watchdog false. Three received usage reports remain in the official aggregate; the fourth recorded forwarding attempt has no usage report and receives the registered reserve. SDK stderr warnings about skipped non-OpenAI reasoning parts are retained; no causal explanation of the stalled response is established. No external solution retrieval,protected-input mutation or researcher recovery occurred. Independent green endpoint does not repair missing agent verification or delivery.
